description: Validation rules for the Apex Manufacturing FY2024 income statement spreading. Each rule defines a mathematical relationship between accounts. 'add' accounts are summed, 'subtract' accounts are subtracted, and the result must equal the 'equals' account within 'tolerance' dollars.

rules.name: Revenue Components Sum
rules.description: Product, Service, and Other Revenue must sum to Total Revenue.

rules.name: COGS Components Sum
rules.description: Raw Materials, Direct Labor, Manufacturing Overhead, and Other Direct Costs must sum to Total COGS.

rules.name: Gross Profit Calculation
rules.description: Total Revenue minus Total COGS must equal Gross Profit.

rules.name: Operating Expenses Sum
rules.description: SGA, R&D, and D&A must sum to Total Operating Expenses.

rules.name: Operating Income Calculation
rules.description: Gross Profit minus Total Operating Expenses must equal Operating Income.

rules.name: Pre-Tax Income Calculation
rules.description: Operating Income plus Interest Income plus Other Non-Operating minus Interest Expense must equal Pre-Tax Income.

rules.name: Net Income Calculation
rules.description: Pre-Tax Income minus Income Tax Expense must equal Net Income.
